websiteEvidence.evidence: Reachable official contract documentation attributes the exact router separately from controller/factory/gauges. Directory uses this informational source, not an assertion of operating trading frontend or current incentives.

deploymentEvidence.evidence: Official contracts page maps DystRouter01.sol to exact Polygon explorer address. Exact-chain/address source-service record identifies direct DystRouter01 non-proxy deployment. Constructor reads pairCodeHash once from immutable factory; immutable transformations bind factory 0x1d21Db6cde1b18c7E47B0F7F42f4b3F68b9beeC9, wrapped native 0x0d500B1d8E8eF31E21C99d1Db9A6444d3ADf1270 and hash 0x009bce6d7eb00d3d075e5bd9851068137f44bba159f1cde806a268e20baaf2e8. No live RPC check.

abiEvidence.officialComparison: Pinned official router equals deployed source after removing whitespace, not byte-for-byte. Deployed source remains authoritative; no whole-repository or dependency byte identity is claimed.
abiEvidence.evidence: Full deployment-bound ABI retained unchanged; selected fragments are unchanged references from this ABI. Reviewed all router methods plus SafeERC20 transfer encoding. Constructor-bound pair factory and cached hash constrain pair calls; source-service exact_match labels are preserved and do not constitute fresh runtime/dependency attestation. No generic Solidly ABI substitution.

sourceSemantics.routing: Route[] consists only of from/to/stable, not arbitrary calldata. Both loops derive pairs and send empty callback bytes. Fee-supporting loop calls selected pair.getAmountOut directly; does not choose a different pool type for its quote.
sourceSemantics.liquidity: Both desired amounts must be >= corresponding minima before empty/existing-reserve branches. Empty reserves use desired amounts; optimized existing-reserve side additionally checked. No min LP output. Removals use caller LP allowance and pair-burn amounts.
sourceSemantics.native: MATIC ABI names denote Polygon native currency, now POL; immutable wrapped address is legacy WMATIC/WPOL. Three payable functions: token/native add and two native-input swap variants. add refunds dust to caller; native-output methods unwrap and send to recipient via empty calldata.
sourceSemantics.feeSupporting: Native removal transfers whole router token balance. Token/native swap checks and unwraps whole router wrapped balance. Token-output variants check recipient balance delta. Pair quote/fee/reserve and external-token code are not live-attested.
sourceSemantics.excluded: Three permits, UNSAFE caller-supplied per-hop amounts and twelve read-only helpers excluded. Constructor/receive create no capability. No gauges, staking, emissions or controller operations included.
sourceSemantics.lifecycle: Official docs describe historical swaps and incentives, not current fee/incentive or frontend availability proof. No specific shutdown/pause or renewed-live-operation claim is made.

Explicit exact-input token/native swap; path must end with constructor-bound wrapped native currency, pulls caller input, checks calculated output minimum/deadline and unwraps calculated output to recipient.

Explicit token/native fee-supporting swap; caller funds selected path ending in wrapped native token. Checks minimum against entire router wrapped-native balance, unwraps all and pays recipient; deadline checked.

selectedFunctions.label: Dystopia addLiquidity
warnings: Caller selects assets, stable/volatile routes, amounts, minimums, recipient and deadline; token/LP balances and allowances remain required under independent policies. No current fee, price, liquidity or financial-safety assurance.

MATIC-named payable methods spend Polygon native currency (POL today) through constructor-bound WMATIC/WPOL 0x0d500B1d8E8eF31E21C99d1Db9A6444d3ADf1270; nonpayable calls require zero value. Native refund/recipient incompatibility can revert.

Liquidity adds check both desired-amount minima before reserve optimization and optimized-side minimum afterward, but have no minimum LP-output parameter. Removal minimums reflect pair-burn accounting, not post-tax net receipt.

Fee-supporting native removal forwards the entire router token balance; supporting token/native swaps unwrap its entire wrapped-native balance. Nonstandard/rebasing tokens and route continuity can affect or revert execution.

Explicit routes derive pairs from immutable factory and constructor-cached pair-code hash; both swap loops pass empty callback data. No unsafe per-hop amounts, permit, opaque executor, governance, gauge or staking authority is admitted. Source-service exact_match is not a fresh runtime/dependency identity, funding or execution attestation.
